description.value: Poplar Grove Winery is a family-owned, estate-grown winery near Penticton celebrating its 30th vintage, producing a full range of Okanagan reds, whites, and rosés from its own vineyards. The property features a walk-in tasting room and The Restaurant at Poplar Grove, a full-service dining room with a patio offering vineyard views, open seven days a week for lunch and dinner. Cyclists riding through the Penticton bench country will find it a relaxed stop for wine tasting, a sit-down meal, and retail wine purchases including convenient 3-litre bag-in-box formats.
